summary: Verified the ₹0 total-cost bug fix in Alfred chat's Modify→Hotel flow. Ran full Playwright regression across Goa (booking chip), Kerala (inspire→itinerary→book, the originally failing pair), and Jaipur (itinerary flow). 19/19 assertions passed: every hotel card shows a nonzero '₹X / night' label; every cost message after hotel selection matches exact expected math (flight*2 + pricePerNight*3); 3+ modify→hotel loops alternating selections all produce nonzero, correct totals differing between the two hotels; full booking completes through traveller form, contact-form autofill (email correctly derived as priya.tanwar@gmail.com), seat choice, and success message with booking-reference (EMT-XXXXXX).
critical_code_review_comments: computeTotal now deterministically uses pricePerNight from the hotel argument with a positive-number guard — good.
withPrices/hotelsFor normalizer is applied in BOTH initial handleBudgetText and Modify→Hotel handleModifyChoice paths — good, no gap.
handleSelectHotel now computes total from current booking state before setBooking (no setState-updater side effect) — bug fix is sound and testable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend-only scripted app. To reach chat: click [data-testid='alfred-bubble'] first. Booking flow needs 2 day clicks on booking-date-picker button[name='day']:not([disabled]) before booking-date-confirm enables. Budget is sent via [data-testid='chat-input-field'] + [data-testid='chat-send-button']. Total cost bubble is a [data-testid='chat-ai-message'] containing 'total cost comes to ₹X'. Hotel cards: hotel-select-button-{0|1}. Modify loop: booking-chip-modify → modify-chip-hotel.
